messages.subject: Can't deploy my shiny app
parts:
Hi all,

My shiny app is working properly however, I can't deploy or publish it. when I run publish I receive the following error below even those I loaded the two required packages:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 70930...Error: 
* Application depends on package "lubridate" but it is not installed.
   Please resolve before continuing.

* Application depends on package "MASS" but it is not installed.
   Please resolve before continuing.


Thanks for helping!

-Kalbi
